newsitem.title: USA: Manchester to acquire Bitwise unit.
newsitem.headline: Manchester to acquire Bitwise unit.

text.p: Manchester Equipment Co Inc said Thursday that it has signed a contract to acquire substantially all of the assets of Electrograph Systems Inc, a division of Bitwise Designs Inc, for $2.5 million cash.

Manchester, a systems integrator and reseller of computer software, had said in March that it had a letter of intent to buy the unit from Bitwise. Electrograph, headquartered in Hauppauge, N.Y., had 1996 sales of about $16 million and is a reseller of high-end computer graphic and display monitors, Manchester said.
Manchester said Thursday that it expects the acquisition to close on or around April 30.
